        ### Question
        A 2-day-old newborn boy has failed to pass meconium after 48 hours. There is an absence of stool in the rectal vault. Family history is significant for MEN2A syndrome. Which of the following confirms the diagnosis?

        ### Options
        opa. Absence of ganglion cells demonstrated by rectal suction biopsy
opb. Atrophic nerve fibers and decreased acetylcholinesterase activity
opc. Barium enema demonstrating absence of a transition zone
opd. Rectal manometry demonstrating relaxation of the internal anal sphincter with distension of the rectum
ope. Genetic testing confirming mutation in the RET oncogene

### Reasoning Chains per Option:
